test_cases.test_name: Verify Continuous Temperature Monitoring and Data Recording Intervals
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS continuously monitors temperature in GMP storage areas and records readings at intervals not exceeding 5 minutes.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated and operational in all GMP storage areas.
Access to EMS software and data logs is available.

test_steps.action: Observe the EMS dashboard and data logs for a continuous period of at least 15 minutes.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature readings are displayed in real-time for all monitored GMP storage areas.

test_steps.action: Analyze the recorded data logs to determine the time interval between consecutive temperature readings for each sensor.
test_steps.expected_result: The time interval between consecutive temperature readings for each sensor does not exceed 5 minutes.

acceptance_criteria: All GMP storage areas show continuous temperature monitoring.
Data logs confirm temperature readings are captured at intervals of 5 minutes or less.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be recorded accurately and without loss.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Temperature Range, Accuracy, and Alarm Deviation
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS operates within the specified temperature range and accuracy, and generates alerts when temperature deviates from the setpoint.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated and operational in all GMP storage areas.
Access to EMS software and alarm configuration is available.
A calibrated reference thermometer is available for comparison.

test_steps.action: Set a target temperature within the EMS for a specific GMP storage area (e.g., 20°C).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS accepts the setpoint and displays it correctly.

test_steps.action: Using the calibrated reference thermometer, verify the actual temperature in the storage area.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS displayed temperature is within ±0.5°C of the reference thermometer reading.

test_steps.action: Gradually increase or decrease the temperature in the storage area to simulate a deviation of +2°C from the setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alert notification indicating a temperature deviation.

test_steps.action: Gradually increase or decrease the temperature in the storage area to simulate a deviation of -2°C from the setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alert notification indicating a temperature deviation.

acceptance_criteria: EMS temperature readings are accurate within ±0.5°C of a calibrated reference.
Alerts are generated when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint.
Alert notifications are received and logged by the system.
data_integrity_requirements: Temperature readings must be accurate and reflect actual conditions.
Alarm triggers must be reliable and timely.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Vendor Software Unmodified and Data Storage Format
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system uses vendor-supplied software without modification and stores data in the vendor's standard database format.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Access to EMS system logs and configuration files.
Access to EMS system database.

test_steps.action: Access the EMS system's software installation directory and review file properties and timestamps to confirm no unauthorized modifications have been made.
test_steps.expected_result: All EMS software files are confirmed to be vendor-supplied and unmodified.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of file properties and timestamps.

test_steps.action: Query the EMS database and examine the structure and format of stored temperature and humidity data.
test_steps.expected_result: The stored data is confirmed to be in the vendor's standard database format.
data_to_capture: Sample data records in their native format.

acceptance_criteria: All EMS software files are verified as vendor-supplied and unmodified.
The format of stored data in the EMS database matches the vendor's standard specification.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be stored in a format that ensures its integrity and is retrievable.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Alarm Notification and System Availability
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system generates alerts within the specified response time for alarm conditions and meets the required system availability.
prerequisites: EMS system is operational and monitoring.
Access to EMS system alarm logs.
Access to site paging system.
Ability to simulate temperature deviations.

test_steps.action: Induce a temperature deviation that triggers an alarm condition (e.g., ±2°C from setpoint). Measure the time from deviation to alarm notification.
test_steps.expected_result: The alarm notification is received within 30 seconds of the temperature deviation.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of notification on paging system.

test_steps.action: Review system logs and monitoring tools to confirm system availability over a defined period (e.g., 24 hours), excluding any documented planned maintenance.
test_steps.expected_result: The system availability is confirmed to be 99.5% or higher.

acceptance_criteria: Alarm notifications are generated and received within 30 seconds of a deviation.
System availability meets or exceeds 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm events must be accurately logged with timestamps.
System availability ensures continuous monitoring and data capture.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Audit Trail and Electronic Signature Functionality
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system maintains a comprehensive audit trail and supports electronic signatures as per 21 CFR Part 11.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
User accounts with appropriate permissions are created.
A simulated temperature deviation event has occurred.

test_steps.action: Access the audit trail log within the EMS software.
test_steps.expected_result: The audit trail log displays a detailed record of all system events, including user logins, configuration changes, and alarm events.

test_steps.action: Simulate an action requiring an electronic signature (e.g., acknowledging an alarm or approving a report).
test_steps.expected_result: The system prompts for electronic signature credentials and records the signature along with the associated action.

test_steps.action: Review the audit trail to confirm the electronic signature event is logged correctly.
test_steps.expected_result: The audit trail entry for the electronic signature event accurately reflects the user, timestamp, and the action performed.
data_to_capture: Audit trail entry for electronic signature

acceptance_criteria: All system events are logged in the audit trail with sufficient detail.
Electronic signatures are captured and logged accurately for all required actions.
The audit trail is protected from unauthorized modification or deletion.
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must be complete, accurate, and time-stamped.
Electronic signatures must be unique to an individual and linked to the signed document.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Data Archival and Retention Capabilities
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system can archive historical data and retain it for the required 7-year period using vendor's archival feature.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Sufficient historical data exists to perform archival.
Archival storage location is accessible and configured.

test_steps.action: Initiate the data archival process for a defined period of historical data (e.g., 1 year).
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully archives the selected historical data, and the original data is either removed or marked as archived according to vendor specifications.
data_to_capture: Archival job start and end times

test_steps.action: Verify that the archived data is accessible and can be retrieved if needed.
test_steps.expected_result: The archived data can be successfully retrieved and is readable, maintaining its integrity.
data_to_capture: Verification of data integrity after retrieval

test_steps.action: Confirm that the system's data retention policy is configured to meet the 7-year requirement.
test_steps.expected_result: The system's configuration or documentation confirms that data is retained for at least 7 years.
data_to_capture: System configuration settings for data retention

acceptance_criteria: Data archival process completes successfully without errors.
Archived data is retrievable and maintains its integrity.
System configuration or documentation confirms 7-year data retention.
data_integrity_requirements: Archived data must be retained for the specified period.
Archived data must be protected from loss or corruption.
Archived data must be retrievable for review.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Standard Report Generation for Batch Release
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system can generate standard reports as provided by the vendor for use in batch release processes.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Sufficient historical data exists for report generation.
Access to vendor-supplied reporting tools.

test_steps.action: Access the reporting module of the EMS system.
test_steps.expected_result: The reporting module is accessible and displays available report templates.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the reporting module interface.

test_steps.action: Select a standard report template relevant to batch release (e.g., temperature log for a specific period).
test_steps.expected_result: The selected report template is loaded and ready for configuration.
data_to_capture: Name of the selected report template.

test_steps.action: Configure the report parameters (e.g., date range, specific storage areas) as per typical batch release requirements.
test_steps.expected_result: Report parameters are accepted by the system without errors.

test_steps.action: Generate the report.
test_steps.expected_result: The report is generated successfully in the vendor's standard format.

test_steps.action: Review the generated report for accuracy and completeness of data, ensuring it aligns with recorded data and URS-EMS-007.
test_steps.expected_result: The generated report accurately reflects the monitored data for the specified period and areas, and is suitable for batch release.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of report accuracy and completeness.

acceptance_criteria: Standard reports can be generated by the EMS system.
Generated reports are in the vendor's standard format.
Report data is accurate and complete for the specified parameters.
Generated reports meet the requirements for batch release as defined by URS-EMS-007.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-007: Standard reports provided by vendor shall be used for batch release.
data_integrity_requirements: Report data must be accurate and complete.
Report generation process must not alter original data.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Integration with Site Paging System for Alarm Notifications
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system successfully integrates with the site paging system to deliver alarm notifications via the vendor API.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Site paging system is operational and accessible.
Vendor API for alarm notifications is configured and enabled.
Test alarm conditions can be triggered.

test_steps.action: Configure a test alarm condition in the EMS system that would trigger a notification (e.g., temporarily exceed temperature setpoint by >2°C).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS system recognizes the alarm condition.

test_steps.action: Observe the site paging system for incoming alarm notifications.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm notification is received on the site paging system within the specified response time (URS-EMS-011).
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the received alarm notification on the paging system.

test_steps.action: Verify the content of the alarm notification on the paging system for accuracy (e.g., correct location, temperature value, alarm type).
test_steps.expected_result: The alarm notification contains accurate and relevant information about the triggered alarm.
data_to_capture: Details of the alarm notification content.

test_steps.action: Acknowledge the alarm in the EMS system and verify if the notification on the paging system is updated or cleared accordingly (if applicable).
test_steps.expected_result: Alarm status is updated in the EMS system, and if designed, the paging notification reflects this change.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of alarm acknowledgment in EMS.
Observation of paging system status update.

test_steps.action: Review EMS system logs for records of the alarm event and the successful transmission to the paging system via the vendor API.
test_steps.expected_result: System logs confirm the alarm event and the successful integration with the paging system.
data_to_capture: Relevant log entries from the EMS system.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS system successfully sends alarm notifications to the site paging system.
Alarm notifications are received within the specified response time (URS-EMS-011).
Alarm notification content is accurate and informative.
Integration with the paging system utilizes the vendor API as per URS-EMS-015.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-015: Alarm notifications shall integrate with site paging system using vendor API.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm notifications must be transmitted reliably.
Notification content must accurately reflect the alarm condition.

test_cases.test_name: Verify System Response Time for Alarm Conditions
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system responds to alarm conditions within the specified time limit.
prerequisites: EMS system is fully installed and operational.
Temperature sensors are calibrated and functioning.
Alarm setpoints are configured correctly.

test_steps.action: Induce a temperature deviation that triggers an alarm condition in a monitored area.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm notification is generated and displayed on the EMS interface.
data_to_capture: Timestamp of alarm notification on interface

test_steps.action: Measure the time elapsed between the alarm trigger and the appearance of the alarm notification on the EMS interface.
test_steps.expected_result: The elapsed time is less than or equal to 30 seconds.

acceptance_criteria: The system response time for alarm conditions does not exceed 30 seconds.
data_integrity_requirements: Accurate recording of alarm trigger and notification timestamps.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Data Storage Capacity for 10 Years
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system's data storage capacity is sufficient to support a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring data.
prerequisites: EMS system is fully installed and operational.
Data logging is active and recording data.
Access to system logs and storage utilization metrics.

test_steps.action: Determine the current data storage utilization rate based on a representative period of operation (e.g., 1 month).
test_steps.expected_result: A clear and quantifiable data storage utilization rate is established.

test_steps.action: Calculate the projected storage required for 10 years based on the determined utilization rate.
test_steps.expected_result: A projected storage requirement for 10 years is calculated.

test_steps.action: Verify that the installed data storage capacity of the EMS system meets or exceeds the projected 10-year requirement.
test_steps.expected_result: The installed storage capacity is confirmed to be sufficient for 10 years of data.

acceptance_criteria: The system data storage capacity supports a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring.
data_integrity_requirements: Accurate calculation of storage utilization and projection.
